nodes.label: Dalang Digital Blueprint — YouTube Faceless 100 Juta (Bab 4)
nodes.rationale: Provides the ruthless critique methodology and outlier search strategy for validating video topic demand before production. Referenced as the authoritative framework for anti-yes-man content strategy.
nodes.norm_label: dalang digital blueprint — youtube faceless 100 juta (bab 4)

nodes.label: Mentor Viral CTR Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Defines 4 core thumbnail triggers (high contrast, extreme emotion, strange/anomalous visuals, curiosity trigger), 5 click emotions, 4 proven thumbnail patterns, and art style rules for flat 2D educational cartoon thumbnails.

nodes.label: Indonesian Doom-Scrolling Psychological Evaluation Framework
nodes.rationale: A framework for evaluating YouTube metadata and thumbnails based on how Indonesian viewers doom-scroll on mobile — assessing pattern interrupt, focal contrast, emotional intensity, cognitive curiosity gap, and small-screen legibility within <0.5 seconds.

nodes.label: Curiosity Gap Psychological Formula
nodes.rationale: One of three core psychological elements required in every Spensia video title — creates a knowledge gap that compels the viewer to click to resolve the tension. Applied in titles, descriptions, and thumbnail text overlays.

nodes.label: Underdog Angle Formula
nodes.rationale: One of three core psychological elements required in Spensia video titles — frames the topic from an underdog perspective to trigger empathy and rooting interest in Indonesian viewers.

nodes.label: Kontradiksi (Contradiction) Formula
nodes.rationale: One of three core psychological elements required in Spensia video titles — presents a counterintuitive fact that contradicts common assumptions, forcing cognitive re-evaluation.

nodes.label: Spensia Visual Style DNA
nodes.rationale: Flat 2D illustration style with thick black outlines, semi-detailed cartoon style, warm earthy color palette (browns, terracotta, cream, amber), 1280x720px 16:9 canvas, stickman background characters, no photorealism. Referenced across image prompts and thumbnail prompts.

nodes.label: Spensia Faceless Video Production Pipeline
nodes.rationale: End-to-end pipeline: topic research/validation → script writing → script breakdown into visual segments → audio-to-segment forced alignment → per-segment image prompt generation → upload metadata generation → metadata psychological analysis → metadata fixes + thumbnail concept generation → thumbnail vision analysis.
